_comment: Salesforce screens a learner has to click through. Captured by scripts/build/capture-salesforce.mjs over CDP, annotated by scripts/build/annotate.mjs. Nothing is ever saved in the org: the wizard captures walk forward and leave by navigating away.
_org_comment: Setup has to be in English, which follows the user and not the URL. helios-dev holds the same Helios metadata but its only human user is French, so the captures come from the UAT org, read only.

lookups.crewPermSetId: SELECT Id FROM PermissionSet WHERE Name = 'Helios_Delivery_Crew' LIMIT 1
lookups.installationId: SELECT Id FROM Installation__c WHERE Name = 'INST-00001' LIMIT 1
